false_positives.detail: 0.10 RUB = 10% of 1 RUB par (ustav min for prefs). Paid in lean years 2016 and 2020 instead of full dividend. Confirmed by Bashneft IR and dohod.ru.
3699.27 RUB for 2020 = one-off distribution after sale of ZDK Lenzoloto to Polyus (~19.9 bn). Not a split; price gapped ~60% on ex-date.
7.41 (2018) and 11.83 (2019) from real-estate sales (Nikitsky / Tverskaya), ~5.5 bn proceeds. Yields 30-40%+; no share consolidation.
Same as CNTL (equal AO/AP payouts on those years).
0.05 RUB in 2012-2015 crisis years is the actual declared amount (Mechel IR table). Prefs normally = 20% IFRS NI / 138756915; when NI weak they paid nominal 0.05. Not a split.
16 RUB Q1'2024 special after ~10y of zeros/0.10; no split/consolidation found. Later 2025 = 0.55.
Official TransContainer table: 19.29 (FY2008) → 0.16 (FY2009 crisis) → 2.91 (FY2010). Same share count; payout stayed ~10% of NI.
202.5 RUB interim H1'2005 — dumping ~26 bn accumulated cash (Vedomosti 2005-08-15). Real one-off.
Only 2 non-zero pref rows (2011-2012); no corporate action found. Tiny float/illiquid series — ignore for split detection.

notes: Jump detector correctly flagged IRAO reverse split among noise.

Special/asset-sale dividends (LNZLP, CNTL, MFGSP) are real economics, not data errors.
